title: Reflected Rival

sources.title: Mirror Racer
sources.creator: Andrew Berry
sources.mechanic_used: Left/right steering is mirrored onto a blue opponent, while green terrain boosts and red terrain slows the racers.
sources.limitations: The source is a compact canvas demo with its own generated isometric presentation. This benchmark recreates only the mirrored-control and asymmetric-terrain mechanic; its course layout, art, simulation contract, controls pair, and grading replay are original.

transformation.world: A finite, seeded multi-lane course is shown as a visible scrolling terrain board with two labelled racers.
transformation.interaction: Full mode uses arrow keys; simplified mode uses visible left/right proxy buttons. Both produce the same mirrored lane change.
transformation.verification: The server and exported verifier replay every input at its recorded world tick, recompute terrain-adjusted progress for both racers, and require the white racer to finish first.
transformation.assets: No third-party art, code, fonts, or runtime assets are shipped.

license_note: The source site does not attach an explicit software license in the supplied survey record; no source code or presentation asset is copied into this environment.
